answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can mandate registration through verifiable proof-of-burn. Nodes prove validity at each consensus pulse by referencing provably destroyed assets, dispelling the fable of costless persona generation. Adversaries incur the verifiable capital cost of incinerating real wealth, leaving an unspendable ember of burned tokens per fake identity. However, permanent asset destruction penalizes underfunded, honest agents.
